title: Hourly coordinator refresh from the main base, on by default
goal: An hourly job on the main base (NERV-01 until F-016 is done) that dispatches the coordinator refresh unattended, skipping when a recent or running refresh makes it unnecessary
acceptance: Runs only on the main/coordinator base; on by default, with the config off switch github.coordinatorRefresh.enabled (false turns it off); a non-main base never dispatches

Each hour it sends POST /repos/voidbrain/coordinator/actions/workflows/429602416/dispatches with ref main through github.workflow.dispatch, unattended under the early promotion recorded in F-132-T01; nothing else is dispatched by the job
Skips when the latest run (github.runs.status) was created less than 50 minutes ago or is queued or in progress; a failed dispatch is retried at the next hour, never in a loop
One inbox entry per failure streak: the first failure after a success writes one entry, later failures in the same streak write none, and the next success ends the streak
The token comes from the private token file of F-132-T02, placed by the owner in F-132-T06; a missing token skips with a reason and never logs or echoes it

Tests with a fake clock and a fake GitHub API, committed failing first: one dispatch per hour, none on a non-main base, none when switched off, none when the latest run is under 50 minutes old or queued or in progress, one inbox entry per failure streak
Owner decision 2026-11-26 (chat): "Promote the GitHub pilot early", so the hourly coordinator refresh (F-132-T04) runs unattended. Order: F-132-T01, F-132-T02, F-132-T04, F-132-T06.
privacy: Neutral invented repositories, workflows and runs in tests; the GitHub token never in git, config.json, tests, logs, chat or the relocation snapshot.
escalation: A schedule more often than hourly, another workflow or repository, or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one scheduled job on the existing scheduler with main-base and admission checks. Not a measurement. Re-estimated 2026-11-26 after the early promotion: on by default with an off switch, the 50-minute skip and the failure-streak inbox entry (+0.5 h); waits on F-132-T02 instead of F-132-T03.
